newsitem.title: USA: AT&T closes $45/shr sale of AT&T Capital.
newsitem.headline: AT&T closes $45/shr sale of AT&T Capital.

text.p: AT&T Corp said on Tuesday it sold AT&T Capital Corp to a consortium of AT&T Capital management and GRS Holding Co Ltd for $45 per share.
The company said in a statement it was receiving in total over $1.8 billion in cash for the sale of its 86 percent interest in the equipment and financing unit.

After the merger, AT&T Capital said in a separate statement it would be owned by members of senior management, including Chairman and Chief Executive Tom Wajnert, and GRS Holding, which owned a U.K. rail leasing company.
The plan to divest AT&T Capital was part of the company's strategic restructuring announced last year, it said.
